newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indosat says Q1 net up to 132.4 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Indosat says Q1 net up to 132.4 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian telecommunications firm PT Indonesian Satellite Corporation (Indosat) said on Wednesday it posted a consolidated net profit of 132.4 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 114.6 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
It said earnings per share (EPS) in the quarter were up to 127.8 rupiah against 110.7 rupiah in the year-ago period.

"Our first quarter 1997 result has shown our strong commitment to maintain that operating expenses grow slower than operating revenues, which resulted in 17.5 percent growth in operating income," president and chief executive officer Tjahjono Soerjodibroto said in a statement.
Indosat said total operating revenues were up to 323.1 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against 278.1 billion rupiah in the year-ago period.
Total operating expenses rose to 170.7 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 from 148.5 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
